name: pi-extensions-source
description: Development checks for the standalone Pi extensions in this repository

scripts.test:security: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'),path=require('node:path'),cp=require('node:child_process');const roots=['compact-tool-ui','relay-footer','relay-providers','subagent','web'].map(name=>path.join('extensions',name));const walk=dir=>fs.readdirSync(dir,{withFileTypes:true}).flatMap(entry=>entry.isDirectory()?walk(path.join(dir,entry.name)):[path.join(dir,entry.name)]);const files=roots.flatMap(walk).filter(file=>/\.(?:test|spec)\.(?:ts|[cm]?js)$/.test(file)).sort();const required=['extensions/web/security.test.ts','extensions/subagent/security.test.ts'].map(path.normalize);const missing=required.filter(file=>!files.includes(file));if(missing.length)throw new Error('Missing required security tests: '+missing.join(', '));const result=cp.spawnSync(process.execPath,['--test',...files],{stdio:'inherit'});if(result.error)throw result.error;process.exit(result.status??1)"
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test:security && npm run test:mcp
